newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL AND GERMANY DRAW 0-0 IN LISBON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL AND GERMANY DRAW 0-0 IN LISBON.

text.p: Germany survived some intense final pressure from a lively Portugal to hold on for a 0-0 draw in a World Cup European group nine qualifier in Lisbon on Saturday.

After dominating the first half, the reigning European champions found themselves under increasing seige and only a fine save from goalkeeper Andreas Koepke denied Portugal's Joao Vieira Pinto with 10 minutes remaining.
Vieira Pinto dribbled across the front of the area before cutting into the box, but Koepke dived to his left to block what had been the clearest chance of the game.

The result leaves the Portuguese at the top of the qualifying group with eight points from five games, three more than Germany, who have played two fewer games, and two more than second-placed Ukraine.
